about: Shelf & Shaker's collection queue. Each month a premiere list of 10 distinctive drinks is added here (status 'collected', collection 'premiere-YYYY-MM'); they are NOT in the app yet. Drinks that turn out to be variations of catalog drinks are kept as status 'reserve'. A release, only when requested, moves collected drinks into index.html with tools/release_pending.py and sets status 'released'. 'photo' turns true once the drink's ChatGPT image is staged. pending/index.html turns every drink with photo:false into ChatGPT image prompts, three drinks per image. Status 'reshoot' marks a drink already in the app whose photo is being replaced (install with add_user.py --replace, then set photo:true); the release script ignores it.

drinks.name: Branca Smash

drinks.name: Gentle Breeze

drinks.name: Final Ward
drinks.note: Created by bartender Phil Ward at Death & Co in New York in 2007 as a rye-whiskey riff on the Last Word.

drinks.name: Mexican Firing Squad

drinks.name: Japanese Cocktail
drinks.note: An 1860s creation credited to bartender Jerry Thomas, notable for using orgeat syrup instead of plain sugar to sweeten a brandy sour.

drinks.name: Kentucky Buck

drinks.scene: a sunlit Kentucky horse-farm porch with white picket fencing and bluegrass pasture blurred beyond, warm late-afternoon light, a small basket of lemons

drinks.name: Satan's Whiskers

drinks.look: chilled coupe of bright orange-amber, clear and glossy, an orange twist
drinks.scene: the art deco American Bar of a grand 1930s London hotel, black-and-gold geometric tile and a polished brass rail catching soft lamplight, a few curled orange peels on a silver tray

drinks.name: Vodka Tonic

drinks.scene: a wooden lakeside dock at a Nordic summer cabin, birch trees and still blue water blurred beyond, warm golden evening light

drinks.name: Nutty Irishman
drinks.reason: Recipe has no garnish but the photo shows a spice dusting on top

drinks.scene: a snug in an old Irish pub, dark carved wood paneling, a frosted-glass partition and a warm peat-fire glow blurred behind

drinks.name: Bijou

drinks.name: Brooklyn

drinks.look: chilled coupe of pale golden amber, clear and glossy, a skewered dark cherry
drinks.scene: a 1900s Brooklyn brownstone parlour with the Brooklyn Bridge glowing through a tall window at dusk

drinks.name: Jack Rose
drinks.note: Shake with ice and fine-strain into a chilled glass. An apple-brandy sour dating to 1908 and one of the founding drinks of the sour family.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of soft rose-pink, clear and glossy, a lemon twist
drinks.scene: a New England apple orchard at golden hour, rustic wooden crates of red apples blurred behind

drinks.name: Pegu Club
drinks.note: Shake with ice and fine-strain into a chilled coupe. The house drink of the Pegu Club, a British officers' club in Rangoon, Burma, in the 1920s.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of pale citrus-gold, clear and glossy, a lime wedge on the rim
drinks.scene: a colonial-era Burmese club veranda with teak shutters, rattan chairs and slow ceiling fans, tropical green beyond

drinks.name: Army & Navy
drinks.note: Shake with ice and fine-strain into a chilled coupe. A gin sour sweetened with almond orgeat, first printed in David Embury's 1948 book.

drinks.scene: a wood-panelled officers' club library with brass ship instruments and leather armchairs

drinks.name: Bobby Burns
drinks.note: Stir with ice and fine-strain into a chilled coupe. A Scotch Manhattan with a touch of Bénédictine, named for the poet Robert Burns.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of deep mahogany-amber, clear and glossy, a skewered dark cherry
drinks.scene: a Scottish Highland lodge on Burns Night, tartan throws, a stone hearth and candlelight

drinks.name: Widow's Kiss
drinks.note: Stir with ice and strain into a chilled glass. Created by George Kappeler at New York's Holland House Hotel and printed in his 1895 book.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of rich golden-amber, clear and glossy, two skewered dark cherries
drinks.scene: a candlelit Victorian hotel bar with dark carved wood, a gilt mirror and lace curtains

drinks.name: Twentieth Century
drinks.note: Shake with ice and fine-strain into a chilled coupe. Named after the 20th Century Limited express train; first printed in the 1937 Café Royal Cocktail Book.

drinks.scene: an Art Deco 1930s railway dining car with polished chrome, etched glass and a blurred landscape through the window

drinks.name: Chrysanthemum
drinks.note: Stir with ice and fine-strain into a chilled glass. A low-strength aperitif from Hugo Ensslin's 1917 book, later served aboard ocean liners.

drinks.scene: a Japanese garden teahouse in autumn, golden chrysanthemums and a paper lantern glowing softly behind

drinks.name: Bitter Giuseppe
drinks.note: Express a lemon peel into the mixing glass, stir with ice and strain over a large cube. Created in 2007 by Stephen Cole at The Violet Hour in Chicago.
drinks.look: rocks glass with one large clear ice cube, deep brown-burgundy, a lemon twist
drinks.scene: a Chicago speakeasy with tall velvet wingback chairs, chandeliers and moody candlelight

drinks.name: Trident
drinks.note: Stir with ice and strain into an ice-filled glass. A bone-dry Nordic-Italian twist on the Negroni using aquavit, sherry and Cynar.
drinks.look: rocks glass with clear ice, warm russet-amber, a lemon twist
drinks.scene: a Norwegian fjord-side boathouse at twilight, weathered red timber and still dark water beyond

drinks.name: Fog Cutter
drinks.note: Shake all but the sherry with ice, strain over crushed ice and float the sherry on top. A Trader Vic's tiki classic from the 1940s.
drinks.look: collins glass of crushed ice, cloudy golden-orange with a darker sherry layer on top, a bouquet of mint sprigs

drinks.name: Jasmine
drinks.note: Shake with ice and fine-strain into a chilled coupe. Created in the 1990s by Paul Harrington in Emeryville, California; it tastes remarkably like grapefruit.

drinks.scene: a 1990s California bistro bar with warm blond wood, jasmine vines climbing a sunlit window

drinks.name: Blinker
drinks.note: Shake with ice and fine-strain into a chilled coupe. A rye and grapefruit sour from the 1930s.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of coral-pink, lightly cloudy and silky, a grapefruit twist
drinks.scene: a 1930s roadside diner at dawn with chrome trim, a neon sign and red vinyl stools blurred behind

drinks.name: Cameron's Kick
drinks.note: Shake with ice and fine-strain into a chilled coupe. A Scotch and Irish whiskey sour with orgeat, first printed in 1922.

drinks.name: Diamondback
drinks.note: Stir with ice and strain into a chilled glass. From Ted Saucier's 1951 book Bottoms Up.

drinks.look: collins glass with clear ice and a celery-salt rim, rich brick-red, a pickled green bean standing in the glass

drinks.name: Saturn

drinks.look: tall glass of smooth frozen pale-golden slush, a cherry encircled by a lemon-peel ring like a planet
drinks.scene: a 1960s space-age lounge with an atomic starburst clock, a curved white bar and a night sky full of stars

drinks.name: Hotel Nacional Special
drinks.note: Shake with ice and fine-strain into a chilled coupe. Named for Havana's grand Hotel Nacional de Cuba in the 1930s.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of pale apricot-gold, lightly cloudy and silky, a pineapple wedge on the rim
drinks.scene: the grand terrace of a 1930s Havana hotel, palm trees, a colonnade and the Malecón seawall in late sun

drinks.name: Trident
drinks.note: Stir with ice and strain into an ice-filled glass. A bone-dry Nordic-Italian twist on the Negroni using aquavit, sherry and Cynar.
drinks.reason: Photo is a near-twin of Bitter Giuseppe (same rocks glass, single big cube, lemon twist, red-brown colour)
drinks.look: rocks glass filled with several smaller clear ice cubes, lighter translucent copper-russet with golden highlights, a long thin lemon peel spiralling down inside the glass against the ice

drinks.name: Tom and Jerry
drinks.note: Batter (serves 6): beat 2 egg yolks with 6 barspoons sugar, ½ oz Jamaican rum and a pinch each of cinnamon, clove and nutmeg; whisk 2 whites stiff and fold in. Per drink, stir 2 tbsp batter with the brandy and rum in a warmed mug, top with hot (not boiling) water and dust with nutmeg. A 19th-century American Christmas tradition, served from a matching punch bowl and mugs.
drinks.look: white ceramic Tom and Jerry mug with a plain thin gold rim, pale creamy-beige drink with a thick frothy cream-colored head dusted with grated nutmeg, a faint wisp of steam
drinks.scene: a cozy Victorian parlour at Christmas, a decorated tree with glowing candles and a crackling fireplace softly blurred behind

drinks.name: Mulled Wine
drinks.garnish: Orange wheel studded with cloves, cinnamon stick
drinks.note: Warm everything gently in a pan without boiling (or build in a warmed mug and top with hot water). Europe's classic Christmas-market warmer, known as Glühwein in Germany.
drinks.look: clear glass mug with a handle, deep ruby-red hot spiced wine, a clove-studded orange wheel and a cinnamon stick, a faint wisp of steam
drinks.scene: a snowy German Christmas market at dusk, wooden stalls strung with warm fairy lights softly blurred behind

drinks.name: Hot Buttered Rum

drinks.scene: a snowed-in New England log cabin, a woollen blanket, snow piled on the window sill and a woodstove glow softly blurred behind

drinks.name: Coquito

drinks.scene: a festive Puerto Rican home at Christmas, colourful parranda string lights, a guitar and poinsettias softly blurred behind

drinks.name: Snowball

drinks.reason: First image showed pebbled dots over the glass and liquid and crackled ice

drinks.name: Bombardino

drinks.name: Poinsettia

drinks.name: Ritz Cocktail

drinks.name: Sgroppino

drinks.name: Maple Ginger Switchel

drinks.scene: a colorful Oaxacan market stall, woven textiles, a pile of green chiles, vivid midday light

drinks.name: Peach Mint Iced Tea
drinks.note: Shake with ice and pour unstrained into the jar.
drinks.look: glass mason jar with ice, hazy peach-amber, a mint sprig and a peach slice
drinks.scene: a Georgia front porch, white rocking chair, a basket of peaches, warm golden late light

drinks.name: Zero-Proof Sour
drinks.note: Dry-shake without ice to build the foam, then shake hard with ice and double-strain into a chilled coupe.
drinks.look: chilled coupe without ice, pale cloudy lemon-cream with a thick smooth white foam top, a lemon twist
drinks.scene: a dim art-deco cocktail lounge, brass bar rail, velvet banquette, soft amber light

drinks.name: Blood Orange Tonic
drinks.note: Build over ice, pouring the tonic slowly so the color fades from crimson to pale.
drinks.look: highball glass with ice, crimson at the bottom fading up to pale sparkling tonic, a blood orange wheel
drinks.scene: a Sicilian citrus grove at dusk, a stone wall, a crate of blood oranges, warm rosy light

drinks.name: Raspberry Lime Rickey
drinks.note: Lightly crush the raspberries with the lime and syrup, fill with ice and top with soda; a Boston soda-fountain staple.
drinks.look: tall collins glass with ice, bright raspberry-red and sparkling, raspberries and a lime wedge
drinks.scene: a New England seaside soda shop, white beadboard walls, a striped awning visible outside, crisp bright light

drinks.name: Strawberry Basil Lemonade
drinks.note: Muddle the strawberries and basil, add the lemonade and ice, stir and strain into a flute to toast the finish line.
drinks.look: champagne flute without ice, translucent strawberry-pink lemonade with tiny bubbles, a strawberry on the rim and a basil leaf
drinks.scene: a festive rooftop at night with soft string lights and a city skyline blurred behind, a celebratory mood

drinks.name: Orange Blossom Fizz
drinks.note: Dry-shake without ice, shake again hard with ice, strain into a chilled glass and top slowly with soda so the foam rises above the rim.
drinks.look: tall collins glass without ice, pale cloudy orange-cream with a tall smooth white foam head rising just above the rim, a twist of orange zest
drinks.scene: a Moroccan riad courtyard, carved plaster arches, a small tiled fountain, orange blossoms on a brass tray, soft morning light

drinks.name: Angel Face
drinks.note: Shake hard with ice and strain into a chilled coupe; equal parts, bone-dry and fruity, from London's 1930s hotel bars.
drinks.look: chilled coupe without ice, clear warm golden-amber
drinks.scene: a pale art-deco London hotel bar, cream walls and brass, soft morning light through tall windows, a bowl of apricots

drinks.name: Canchanchara
drinks.note: Stir the honey syrup and lime in the cup, add cracked ice and the rum, then stir hard from the bottom up; Cuba's earliest rum mix, from Trinidad.
drinks.look: rustic unglazed terracotta clay cup with cracked ice, pale cloudy straw-gold, a lime wedge
drinks.scene: a colonial Trinidad, Cuba street café, pastel walls and cobblestones, warm afternoon sun, a honey jar

drinks.name: Chartreuse Swizzle
drinks.note: Swizzle with crushed ice until the glass frosts, top with more crushed ice and finish with mint and nutmeg; a San Francisco modern classic.
drinks.look: tall collins glass packed with crushed ice, frosted outside, pale vivid green-gold, a mint sprig and grated nutmeg on top
drinks.scene: a foggy San Francisco bar window at dusk, cable-car city lights blurred outside, dark wood counter

drinks.name: Don's Special Daiquiri
drinks.note: Flash-blend with crushed ice, pour into a footed glass and crown with more crushed ice; a 1930s Hollywood tiki original.
drinks.look: footed goblet with crushed ice, hazy golden-yellow, half a passion fruit on the rim
drinks.scene: a 1930s Hollywood tiki bar, bamboo walls, glowing puffer-fish lamps, warm amber light

drinks.name: Horse's Neck
drinks.note: Hang a long spiral of lemon peel inside the glass, fill with ice, add the brandy and top with ginger ale.
drinks.look: tall highball glass with ice, pale amber and sparkling, one very long lemon peel spiral coiling from the rim down inside the glass
drinks.scene: an English country pub by a stable yard, worn oak bar, a horseshoe on the wall, soft golden light

drinks.name: Passion Ginger Tiki
drinks.note: Muddle the ginger in the shaker, add everything else, shake hard with ice and strain over pebbled ice; a modern tiki build with a nutty edge.
drinks.look: tall curvy hurricane glass with pebbled ice, opaque sunny golden-orange, a dried pineapple slice and a citrus wheel
drinks.scene: a lush Polynesian garden lounge at night, carved wooden tiki posts, torches glowing, palm leaves

drinks.name: Illegal
drinks.note: Shake hard with ice and strain into a chilled coupe, or over ice in a clay cup; smoky, bright and a little funky.
drinks.look: chilled coupe without ice, pale cloudy lime-straw with a fine thin foam
drinks.scene: a dim Oaxacan mezcaleria, adobe wall, candlelight, clay copitas on a wooden shelf

drinks.name: Kir
drinks.note: Pour the cassis into a chilled glass and top with cold dry white wine; the Burgundy aperitif named for a mayor of Dijon.
drinks.look: chilled white wine glass without ice, clear rosy-pink
drinks.scene: a Burgundy village café terrace, stone wall with vines, late-afternoon sun, a small dish of blackcurrants

drinks.name: Missionary's Downfall
drinks.note: Blend everything with a half cup of crushed ice until smooth and pour into a large stemmed glass; a frosty, minty 1940s tiki cooler.
drinks.look: large stemmed goblet, frosty opaque pale green-gold slush, a mint sprig and a pineapple slice
drinks.scene: a breezy veranda of an old Pacific mission, whitewashed arches, palm shade, bright tropical light

drinks.name: Paradise
drinks.note: Shake with ice and strain into a chilled coupe; a soft, sunny 1920s gin sour without the sour.
drinks.look: chilled coupe without ice, hazy soft apricot-orange
drinks.scene: a sunlit 1920s orangery, white wrought iron, potted citrus trees, warm hazy glow

drinks.name: Pornstar Martini
drinks.garnish: Half a passion fruit; sparkling wine on the side
drinks.note: Shake hard with ice, double-strain into a chilled coupe, float half a passion fruit and serve a small glass of sparkling wine alongside; a 2000s London favourite.
drinks.look: large chilled coupe without ice, opaque golden-yellow with a light froth, half a passion fruit floating, a small shot glass of sparkling wine beside it
drinks.scene: a sleek London cocktail lounge, dark velvet and gold, moody low light, city lights in a window

drinks.name: Porto Flip
drinks.note: Shake very hard with ice and strain into a small chilled coupe; finish with fresh nutmeg.
drinks.look: small chilled coupe without ice, silky opaque ruby-rose with a dusting of nutmeg
drinks.scene: a Porto wine lodge cellar, barrels stacked behind, candlelight on stone, the Douro at night

drinks.name: Rabo de Galo
drinks.note: Build in a rocks glass, add ice and stir briefly; Brazil's bittersweet answer to the Manhattan.
drinks.look: rocks glass with ice, clear deep reddish-amber, an orange twist
drinks.scene: a São Paulo neighborhood boteco, tiled walls, a beer-crate stool, warm evening light

drinks.name: Spicy Fifty
drinks.note: Shake everything with ice and double-strain into a chilled coupe; floral, sweet and gently hot.
drinks.look: chilled coupe without ice, pale cloudy greenish-straw, one thin red chili laid on the rim
drinks.scene: a modern London bar counter in green marble, brass details, a scatter of red chilies, soft evening light

drinks.name: Three Dots and a Dash
drinks.garnish: Three cherries and a pineapple chunk
drinks.note: Flash-blend with crushed ice and pour into a footed glass, topped with more ice; best with aged rhum agricole and a splash of aged rum. Named for Morse code's V for victory, 1940s.
drinks.look: footed goblet with crushed ice, hazy golden-amber, three cherries on a pick and a rectangular pineapple chunk
drinks.scene: a 1940s tiki bar with a nautical theme, ship's wheel and rope netting, warm lantern light

drinks.name: Ve.N.To
drinks.note: Shake hard with ice and strain over fresh ice; for the full effect make the honey syrup with chamomile tea instead of water. A modern Venetian grappa sour.
drinks.look: small rocks tumbler with ice, pale cloudy straw-yellow, a lemon zest and a small cluster of white grapes
drinks.scene: a Venetian canal-side bar, weathered pastel walls, a gondola mooring post, soft hazy morning light

drinks.name: Grand Margarita
drinks.note: Rim a rocks glass with sea salt and fill it with ice. Shake everything hard with ice for about 10 seconds and strain into the glass. A richer, orange-forward Margarita made with 100% agave tequila and Grand Marnier.
drinks.look: rocks glass over ice with a coarse sea-salt rim, clear pale amber-gold, one lime slice on the rim
drinks.scene: a Mexican hacienda courtyard at dusk, terracotta tiles and a carved wooden bar top, a bowl of limes, warm lantern light

drinks.name: Picon Punch
drinks.note: Build the amer and grenadine over ice, top with soda, then float the brandy over the top. A bittersweet orange highball still poured as the house drink in Nevada's Basque restaurants.
drinks.look: highball glass with ice, bright orange-amber and sparkling, a lemon twist
drinks.scene: a worn wooden bar top in a small Basque-American restaurant, string lights and old black-and-white photos on the wall, a quiet high-desert evening outside the window

drinks.name: Bicicletta
drinks.note: Build chilled dry white wine and Campari over ice in a wine glass, then top with a splash of soda; a low-proof Milanese spritz mild enough to drink before the bike ride home.
drinks.look: wine glass with ice, bright reddish-orange and sparkling, an orange wheel
drinks.scene: a small marble café table on a narrow Milan side street, striped awning shade, a bicycle leaning against the wall nearby

drinks.name: Siesta
drinks.note: Shake tequila, Campari, grapefruit and lime juices, and syrup hard with ice; strain into a chilled coupe. A bitter-citrus riff on the Hemingway Daiquiri's sour template, built around agave instead of rum.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of pale rose-pink, a grapefruit twist
drinks.scene: a sun-bleached poolside lounge chair on red clay tile, bright midday light, a halved grapefruit resting on the table

drinks.name: Alaska
drinks.note: Stir gin and Yellow Chartreuse with ice; strain into a chilled coupe. A Prohibition-era Savoy creation that swaps a Martini's vermouth for an herbal French liqueur.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of pale chartreuse-yellow, clear, a lemon twist
drinks.scene: a snow-dusted cabin windowsill at dusk, warm lamplight glowing inside, pine boughs and frost on the glass

drinks.name: Royal Bermuda Yacht Club
drinks.note: Shake gold rum with falernum and dry curaçao; strain into a chilled coupe. Trader Vic's entry in the daiquiri family, first poured for members of Bermuda's yacht club.
drinks.look: chilled coupe of warm amber-gold, clear
drinks.scene: a weathered dock at a yacht club marina, white sails and blue water in soft afternoon light, coiled rope on a piling

drinks.name: Michelada
drinks.note: Rub the rim with lime and dip it in coarse salt, fill the glass with ice, add the lime and both sauces, then pour in ice-cold lager and stir once. Mexico's savory beer cooler; add a splash of tomato juice if you like it redder.
drinks.look: tall collins glass with ice and a thick coarse-salt rim, hazy golden lager with a light head, a lime wedge on the rim, a bottle of red hot sauce beside it
drinks.scene: a sunny Mexico City street-side cantina, painted tile counter, papel picado flags overhead, bright midday light

drinks.name: Ti' Punch
drinks.note: Squeeze a coin of lime peel, with a little flesh on it, into a small glass, add the cane syrup and rhum and stir until the syrup disappears. Ice is optional. Martinique's everyday aperitif, made to your own taste.
drinks.look: small heavy rocks glass with one or two ice cubes, crystal-clear pale straw, a round coin of lime peel resting in the drink, a small wooden swizzle stick beside it
drinks.scene: a Martinique veranda at golden hour, sugar-cane fields and a rum distillery chimney in the distance, louvered shutters, warm light

drinks.name: Carajillo
drinks.note: Shake the liqueur and a fresh hot espresso hard with ice until a thick foam forms, then strain over fresh ice. Spain's after-dinner coffee, now the drink of choice in Mexico City.
drinks.look: rocks glass with ice, layered look: deep coffee-brown below a creamy tan foam, three coffee beans on the foam
drinks.scene: a late-night Madrid tapas bar, zinc counter, hanging jamón and tiled walls, warm low light, an espresso machine behind

drinks.name: Improved Holland Gin Cocktail
drinks.note: Stir with ice and strain over a large cube, then express a lemon twist over the top. Malty genever with a whisper of cherry and anise; an 1870s 'improved' cocktail.
drinks.look: small cut-crystal rocks glass with one large clear cube, clear pale-gold, a lemon twist
drinks.scene: a Victorian American saloon, dark mahogany back bar, gaslight glow, a stoneware genever crock on the counter

drinks.name: English Milk Punch
drinks.note: Make it ahead by the batch: mix everything except the milk, pour it into cold milk and let it curdle for an hour, then strain it slowly through a coffee filter until crystal clear. Serve over a large cube. Clarified punch keeps for weeks; the English were making it by 1711.
drinks.look: rocks glass with one large clear cube, perfectly crystal-clear pale-amber liquid, a lemon twist
drinks.scene: an 18th-century English tavern, dark oak beams, a silver punch bowl and pewter on the table, candlelight

drinks.name: Absinthe Drip
drinks.note: Pour the absinthe into the glass, rest a slotted spoon with a sugar cube across the rim and drip about 4 oz of ice-cold water over the sugar until the drink turns milky, then stir. The 19th-century Paris ritual.
drinks.look: stemmed reservoir absinthe glass, opalescent cloudy pale green, a slotted silver absinthe spoon with a half-melted sugar cube across the rim, water dripping
drinks.scene: a Belle Époque Paris café, marble table, a glass absinthe water fountain beside the glass, gaslit evening

drinks.name: Sangria
drinks.note: Best by the pitcher: mix the wine, brandy, orange liqueur and syrup with sliced orange, lemon and apple, and chill for two to four hours. Pour over ice and top each glass with soda. Spain's summer punch.
drinks.look: large stemmed wine glass with ice, deep ruby-red, slices of orange, lemon and apple in the glass, a clay pitcher of sangria beside it
drinks.scene: a sunny Andalusian courtyard, whitewashed walls, potted geraniums, a tiled table, dappled shade

drinks.name: Rebujito
drinks.note: Fill a tall glass with ice and a few mint leaves, pour in chilled dry fino or manzanilla sherry and top with lemon-lime soda. Andalusia's festival cooler.
drinks.look: tall highball glass with ice, pale sparkling straw-gold, mint leaves inside and a mint sprig on top
drinks.scene: a festive Seville fair tent, striped red-and-white awning, paper lanterns, flamenco dresses blurred in the background, evening light

drinks.name: Café Brûlot
drinks.note: Warm the cognac, orange liqueur, sugar, cloves, cinnamon and orange peel in a heatproof bowl, light it with care and stir until the sugar melts, then pour in hot strong coffee to put out the flame and ladle into cups. New Orleans' flaming tableside finale. Use a long-handled ladle and keep the flame clear of anything that can catch.
drinks.look: clear heatproof glass coffee cup on a saucer, glossy dark-brown coffee, a long clove-studded orange peel spiral curling over the rim, a silver brûlot bowl with soft blue flames softly blurred behind it
drinks.scene: an old New Orleans dining room, white tablecloths, dark wood panelling and brass, dim romantic light
